messages:
Ava L: Hi folks -- I9m in APAC and my calendar shows the orientation at 02:00 local which seems wrong. The event says 09:00 PT. Can someone confirm the UTC time and share the meeting link? Also would love to know where recordings go.

Diego R: Welcome Ava! :wave: 09:00 PT is 16:00 UTC. For AEST that should be 02:00+1 (next day) depending on DST, so double-check with a converter. Zoom link is in the "Redwood Onboarding" calendar entry, but some clients strip details. I9ll paste it here: https://zoom.us/j/3456789012 (passcode: onboard)

Onboarding Bot: Reminder: Orientation events default to Pacific Time. Recording + transcript will be uploaded to Drive: https://drive.reddemo.company/onboarding/ within 24 hours.

Ava L: Thanks Diego. My invite didn9t have the link; I only received the mailer. Is there a policy to include explicit timezone labels in the event description? It would help international hires.

Marta (People Ops): Good feedback  we9ll update invites to include explicit times for PT/UTC and a short table of common time zones (ET/CET/AEST). For this session we9ll also add a pinned agenda in the Drive folder and ask Recording to add chapters.

Sam (Calendar Ops): Quick tip: if you see a duplicate invite, open the one from the shared "Redwood Onboarding" calendar (not the email copy). Some clients (Outlook mobile, Apple Calendar) merge duplicates and hide links. If anyone still can9t access the Drive recording after posting, DM me and I9ll grant access.

Ava L: Perfect. One last question: will there be a separate regional Q&A recording? I might need the regional session timing.

Diego R: Yes, there9s a REGIONS office hours block later the same day at 14:00 PT. It9s optional but the recording will also be saved in the same Drive folder under a subfolder named "REGIONS-<date>".

Ava L: Great, thanks everyone. I9ll accept the invite and set a local reminder so I don9t miss it at 02:00.

Onboarding Bot: Scheduled task set: post orientation recording to Drive in 24h.
